rationale_bullets: Fox (55.0/196) finished '25 as the first WVU true-freshman starter since 1952: 1,276 at 59% (7-6) plus 201 rushing, with both B12 wins (45-35 over #22 Houston, Colorado) and the 301-yard TCU near-miss - the narrative is ahead of the tape grade.
Hawkins (74.1/34; Oklahoma) is Athlon's printed QB1 - '24 true-FR starts 'in a tough spot,' 'the mobile QB Rich Rod covets' (PS).
RichRod (attributed): 'deepest QB room he has ever had' - two capable dual-threats, neither with a proven full season, in the scheme that most amplifies the position.
44 = below average from a 7th-pctile PASS base, with real scheme-fit upside.
data_gaps: Neither has a full proven season

rationale_bullets: Cam Cook (85.9) arrives as the Division I rushing champ - 1,659 and 16 TD at 5.6 at Jacksonville State (PS: 2nd-team AA) - imported into exactly the scheme his numbers were built in; 'will be the workhorse' (P6).
Depth is rebuilt on pedigree: 4* FR Latimer (PS#22) as the printed RB2, JC Boswell (1,109 at 9.5), FB Luke, Cheeks (PS#41).
The departed room produced the worst unit percentile in the B12 set (RUN 2nd pctile) amid the injury cascade - the floor is low and the import is real. G5 guard on the 85.9 (CUSA).
52 = average-plus: elite G5 volume + scheme fit, behind an unproven line.
data_gaps: Zero returning FBS carries of note
grades_detail.g5_guard_note: Cook's 85.9/1,659 is CUSA-graded; scheme-fit + workhorse role hold the unit above average

rationale_bullets: Bray returns as 'the clear #1 receiver to build around' (P6) - a yr-4 medical-return (documented; Athlon May WR1 in bold) with zero 2025 tape after the early season-ending injury.

The rotation is transfers: Epps (68.2; Troy slot starter + return man), Neider (69.3 UConn), Strachan (USC via Boise), Francis (LSU Top200 FR); TE = Ward plus P4 backups Ball (6'7) and Sapp, with 12-personnel plans.
The departed trio (Vaughn 66.7, Weimer, Gallagher) led a 10th-pctile RECV room that totaled 1,116 WR yards - the bar is on the floor.
44 = fringe-below-average: one proven-in-2024 piece plus projection.

rationale_bullets: Two starters return (Krahe 63.5/860 - HM All-B12; Livingston 64.7/754) and the import volume is real: Grayson (68.5/1008; 1st-team CUSA), Casady (72.1/774 UConn - best incoming tape), King (66.2/683), Vass (55.3/420; KSU's final seven starts), plus Top100 FR Brown with 'instant starter' framing - ~120 career starts in the room.
The coach is the story: Rick Trickett hired back for his 53rd season - the 2001-06 WVU lines and JSU's top-five rushing lines are his resume; Athlon calls the line 'the engine of the offense.'
The base is the floor: #121 Run Push / #120 Pass Pro, a 9% sack rate, RBLK 8th pctile.
46 = fringe-below-average: proven mass + coach prior vs a from-the-basement rebuild.
grades_detail.g5_guard_note: Grayson/King/Griffin tape is G5-graded; Casady + the Trickett prior carry the 46

rationale_bullets: All four starters and the top six trench players are gone - All-B12 Vesterinen (71.6/553) graduated; Siders/Grant/Kelly expired; Redwood, Russell, Jones portaled - 7 DL and 48 starts out.

The reload: Gabriel (64.1/287) projected at NT, all-league G5 ends Holloman (70.7/805; 5.5 TFL - 'a major disruptor' per Athlon) and Durham-Campbell (3rd-team SBC; 5 sacks), Haastrup (Oregon Top250), Afogho (66.1/481), JUCO All-American Henson plus a premium JUCO class (PS#3/31/33/69).
The books split: P6 'an upgraded room from 2025 despite the loss'; PS 'should at least equal last year… size up front could be a concern.'
42 = below average from a 46th-pctile RDEF/26th PRSH base: plausible parity, zero proven P4 pieces.
data_gaps: Interior size vs physical B12 fronts
grades_detail.g5_guard_note: Holloman/Durham-Campbell all-league tape is CUSA/SBC-graded; guard holds the unit at 42

rationale_bullets: All three starters depart (#1/#3/#4 tacklers): team tackle leader Perry (64.9/572; the nickel PS files here), sack leader Carrico (62.6/520; 4.5), C.Wilson (57.6/523); Bogle (73.4/255) also left for Arkansas.

Cutter (68.7/311; 2 st, 39 tkl) rises; Stolsky (64.1/540; FAU starter) battles Hood (54.6/366 Illinois); Patterson (UNLV) and Hall (Villanova) among seven adds - '6 with 39+ tackles in a season' (PS).
PS's own summary: 'may not have a star yet, but it'll be a lot deeper.' 40 = below average: volume without a proven B12 piece.
The third all-new secondary in three years: every safety departed plus the top three corners, off a unit that was 10th-pctile COV, #123 PDR, and #66 of 68 P4 opponent-adjusted vs the pass.

The adds are the most real part: Wilson (74.2/801 at Memphis - the best incoming DB tape), Wisconsin starter Latimer (59.8/422) at nickel, Rawlinson (Kent St), Reddic (SFA), Bradford (LSU, PS#100), Powdrell (60.1/738); '25 backups Taylor and Robinson move up; Top100 FR Sieg is the wildcard.
PS: 'same shape as last year but could move up some'; RichRod's length emphasis is the design bet. 40 = below average: real pieces, zero continuity, no proven P4 corner.
data_gaps: Corner room entirely unproven vs P4

rationale_bullets: Everyone is new: the '25 K (10-12, L50), P, KR, and PR all left; the adds are P Hansen (44.1 net at Colorado State - PS's exclamation-point number and the one clear upgrade), K Cassidy (WKU) vs Notaro (Alabama), and Epps on returns.
The '25 unit graded 61st-pctile SPEC but finished #116 in PS's STR - PS projects 'a decent rise with better team depth.'
42 = fringe-below-average: one verified leg (punter), an unproven FG job, new return men.
